conformal_risk_protocol_reference.cluster_aggregation_rule: aggregate accepted-error and acceptance indicators to independent qid cluster first (bounded in [0,1] per qid), then compute exact Clopper-Pearson on qid-level any-accepted-error and deterministic Waudby-Smith/Ramdas betting e-process upper confidence bounds over independent accepted qids; report unavailable at zero accepted qids

e2e_scope: E2E-018/021 private actual CLI success/refusal/tamper/cold replay in owned tests; E2E-020 not applicable: no learning or recovery changes
